sources.title: Transport and environment statistics 2024
facts: DfT reports UK domestic transport greenhouse-gas emissions by transport mode; 2024 domestic transport total is an aggregate national statistic, not a parcel measurement.

sources.title: Transport energy and environment statistics collection
facts: DfT collection links current transport fuel-consumption, greenhouse-gas and air-pollution statistics; collection metadata is provenance rather than a physical emissions observation.

sources.title: Transport energy and environment data tables ENV
facts: ENV tables provide fuel consumption and emissions by transport mode; table values must retain mode, period and unit scope before any downstream use.

sources.title: Transport and environment statistics 2025 announcement
facts: DfT schedules the transport-and-environment 2025-data release for June 2027; the announcement contains no observed 2025 transport-emissions values.

sources.title: Road traffic estimates in Great Britain 2025
facts: DfT reports 2025 vehicle miles by vehicle and road type; traffic activity is an emissions driver but not itself greenhouse-gas emissions.

sources.title: Road traffic estimates 2025 headline figures
facts: The headline release reports 342.6 billion vehicle miles in Great Britain in 2025; vehicle miles require applicable vehicle/fuel factors before emissions can be estimated.

sources.title: Road traffic estimates 2025 by road type
facts: Road-type traffic statistics are compiled from manual counts, automatic counters and road-length data; they are network activity estimates rather than parcel emissions.

sources.title: Road traffic estimates 2025 England road networks
facts: DfT separates Strategic Road Network and local-road traffic in England; road-network activity cannot be assigned directly to a land parcel as emissions.

sources.title: Provisional road traffic estimates Great Britain April 2025 to March 2026
facts: DfT provisional year-ending-March-2026 traffic estimates are activity statistics subject to revision and are not direct greenhouse-gas observations.

sources.title: Vehicle licensing statistics 2025
facts: DfT reports licensed and newly registered vehicles including zero-emission vehicles; registration/stock counts are not physical emissions measurements.

sources.title: Vehicle licensing statistics United Kingdom 2025 detail
facts: The detailed release derives vehicle statistics from DVLA administrative data; zero-emission vehicle status does not by itself quantify lifecycle or grid emissions.

sources.title: UK aviation forecast 2026
facts: DfT forecasts future air passengers, aircraft movements and CO2 emissions; forecast values and scenarios must remain distinct from observed emissions.

sources.title: ONS atmospheric emissions road transport current dataset
facts: ONS road-transport atmospheric-emissions data cover fuel-source emissions for 1990-2024 and include revision history; residence-basis accounting is not parcel-territorial measurement.

sources.title: ONS UK Environmental Accounts 2026 bulletin
facts: ONS Environmental Accounts report residence-basis GHG emissions and energy use; industry and household aggregates must not be assigned directly to parcels.

sources.title: ONS Measuring UK greenhouse gas emissions methodology
facts: ONS distinguishes territorial, residence and footprint measures of UK GHG emissions; these accounting bases are not interchangeable.

sources.title: NAEI emission factors for transport
facts: NAEI publishes fleet-weighted road-transport emission factors by vehicle/source process; a factor requires compatible activity data and scope and is not an observation alone.

sources.title: Maritime emissions modelling framework
facts: DfT documents a maritime model for estimating shipping greenhouse-gas emissions with assumptions and limitations; model outputs are not direct parcel observations.

sources.title: Maritime and shipping statistics collection
facts: DfT maritime statistics cover ports, shipping and freight activity; freight or vessel activity requires a supported emissions method before emissions inference.

sources.title: Renewable Transport Fuel Obligation statistics collection
facts: RTFO statistics describe renewable-fuel supply and certificate activity; fuel supply/certificates are scheme data and not atmospheric emissions observations.

sources.title: RTFO statistics data tables
facts: RTFO tables include renewable fuel volumes, certificates and sustainability characteristics; provisional/final status and obligation year must be preserved.

sources.title: RTFO statistics 2024 final report parent
facts: The 2024 RTFO final release contains a complete annual dataset and records a corrected renewable-fuel-volume figure; revised values supersede the erroneous release text.

sources.title: RTFO statistics 2024 final report detail
facts: The detailed final report separates fuel volume, feedstock, sustainability and certificate metrics; none of those administrative quantities alone is parcel emissions.

sources.title: RTFO statistics 2025 fourth provisional release
facts: The fourth 2025 RTFO release is explicitly provisional and incomplete; it excludes SAF from the RTFO series after the SAF Mandate began in 2025.

sources.title: Renewable Transport Fuel Obligation annual report 2024
facts: DfT annual report describes RTFO scheme value and outcomes; financial/scheme outcomes are not direct greenhouse-gas measurements.

sources.title: Sustainable Aviation Fuel Mandate statistics collection
facts: DfT SAF Mandate statistics track low-carbon aviation-fuel supply and certificate activity; provisional releases are subject to later change.

sources.title: Sustainable Aviation Fuel Mandate statistics data tables
facts: SAF tables include fuel volumes, SAFCs and carbon/sustainability characteristics; these are supply/compliance records rather than observed aircraft emissions.

sources.title: SAF Mandate statistics 2025 first provisional release
facts: The first 2025 SAF Mandate release is an incomplete provisional dataset and must not supersede later provisional releases.

sources.title: SAF Mandate statistics 2025 third provisional release
facts: The third provisional SAF release uses data available to 30 January 2026; it remains incomplete pending the final annual report.

sources.title: SAF Mandate statistics 2025 fourth provisional release
facts: The fourth provisional SAF release uses data available to 27 April 2026; provisional fuel and certificate values remain subject to finalisation.

sources.title: SAF Mandate statistics 2025 fifth provisional release
facts: The fifth provisional SAF release uses data available to 8 July 2026 and is the latest current provisional surface; the final 2025 dataset is scheduled for November 2026.
